stations.name: 90 deg right (R25)
stations.note: Tight square-ish right-hander after a 160 m run-up.

stations.name: Fast sweeper right (R120)
stations.note: Long 90 deg right for high-speed lift-off and throttle-on tests.

stations.name: Esses (R80 right-left-right)
stations.note: Direction change at speed: weight transfer and recovery.

stations.name: Tightening right (R150 into R50)
stations.note: Decreasing radius: the corner that catches you out.

stations.name: Long straight (330 m)
stations.note: Acceleration, top speed, braking, handbrake from speed.

stations.name: Hop (45 mph) then crest (50 mph)
stations.note: Two jumps in line: take-off, landing, settle, repeat.

stations.name: Kicker (short steep ramp)
stations.note: On its own: take-off attitude and landing. Nothing else to recover from.

stations.name: Big air (8 m dome)
stations.note: Its own run-up, so a bad landing off the kicker can't spoil it.

stations.name: Ramp S (0.9 m lip, 6 deg): any speed to 95 mph
stations.note: Game-scale kerb-hop ramp. 65 m run-up; the road is shared with M and L.

stations.name: Ramp M (1.8 m lip, 10 deg): any speed to 95 mph
stations.note: Game-scale stunt ramp. Starts after S's landing.

stations.note: Open tarmac: donuts, power slides, steady-state circles.
